notice: Entirely fictional test data. No real bank, account holder, account number or bank connection.

scenarios.title: Steady income
scenarios.description: Fictional salary and rent in all six months; all balances add up.

expected.notes: All four checks pass. Typical monthly income SGD 4,800; rent SGD 1,600; rent-to-income ratio 33.3%.

scenarios.title: Edited balance
scenarios.description: One fictional balance has been increased by SGD 2,500 without changing its transactions.

expected.notes: Two rows fail the running-balance check. Income and rent may be calculated, but the failed statement must not receive an eligible summary PDF.

scenarios.title: Missing July rent
scenarios.description: Fictional July rent is absent; the remaining running balances are recalculated correctly.

expected.notes: Balances pass. Rent appears in 5 of 6 months, with Jul 2026 named as missing. Typical rent remains SGD 1,600.

scenarios.title: Overdraft
scenarios.description: A fictional low opening balance produces four negative balances in April.

expected.notes: Balances, income and rent pass. Four rows are below zero; the lowest balance is SGD -1,620.50.

scenarios.title: Irregular income
scenarios.description: Fictional monthly receipts vary too widely for the regular-income rule.

expected.notes: Balances and rent pass. No regular income is found, so the rent-to-income ratio is unavailable. This does not mean there was no income.

scenarios.title: Out-of-order transactions
scenarios.description: Two fictional May transactions are swapped while their original balances remain attached.

expected.notes: Dates are out of order and three running-balance rows fail. An eligible summary PDF must not be issued.

scenarios.title: Unreadable amount
scenarios.description: The fictional opening row contains the text not-a-number in its amount column.

expected.notes: Reject the upload with a readable validation error. Do not replace unreadable financial values with zero or issue a result.
